column1: # docs/doc-preserve.tsv — phrases that must SURVIVE compression.
# FORMAT: <path>\t<literal_phrase>     (tabs, not spaces; # and blank lines ignored)
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# The CONTEXT epic cuts documentation cost, and compressing rationale out of
# CLAUDE.md has ALREADY been caught three times removing something load-bearing.
# A byte ceiling on its own rewards deletion indiscriminately: the cheapest way
# to pass a budget is to cut the paragraph explaining why a rule exists, which is
# exactly the paragraph that stops an agent breaking things. This file is the
# counterweight — the budget says "get smaller", this says "not by losing THIS".
# The pairing is deliberate: `doc-check.sh budget` fails if a file is over its
# ceiling OR if a preserved phrase has gone missing, so neither pressure can be
# satisfied by ignoring the other.
# Phrases are matched LITERALLY, after whitespace normalisation, so re-wrapping a
# paragraph is fine and rewording is not. Keep each phrase short enough to
# survive legitimate editing and distinctive enough that an incidental match
# elsewhere is implausible.
# ADDING TO THIS FILE: add the phrase, not the paragraph. If a rule's rationale
# is genuinely superseded, DELETE THE ROW in the same change that removes the
# text — a stale row here blocks correct work, and a gate that blocks correct
# work gets switched off.
# Each row below is a rule whose REASON has been lost or nearly lost before.
